attrs.description: Upscaled global product of GPP and Reco (a combination of autotrophic and heterotrophic respiration) using meta-learning. 206 FLUXNET2015 stations are used to train each variable independently. We use the nighttime-partition for both GPP (GPP_NT) and Reco (RECO_NT). The inputs used are precipitation, vapor pressure deficit (VPD), 2-m air temperature from ERA5 reanalysis data, and LAI + EVI from MODIS. The global product is currently available at 0.25-degree resolution for the year 2001-2022 at a monthly scale

Upscaled global product of GPP and Reco (a combination of autotrophic and heterotrophic respiration) using meta-learning. 206 FLUXNET2015 stations are used to train each variable independently. We use the nighttime-partition for both GPP (GPP_NT) and Reco (RECO_NT). The inputs used are precipitation, vapor pressure deficit (VPD), 2-m air temperature from ERA5 reanalysis data, and LAI + EVI from MODIS. The global product is currently available at 0.25-degree resolution for the year 2001-2022 at a monthly scale
